name: Agent-to-Agent Credential Flow
description: Attacker causes one AI agent to pass its credentials to another agent, creating unauthorized credential delegation chains that bypass intended access controls
real_world_relevance: Multi-agent system credential sharing vulnerabilities (AutoGPT, CrewAI), OAuth token forwarding between chained LLM agents, agentic workflow credential confusion in enterprise deployments

attack_flow.description: Attacker exploits multi-agent communication to create unauthorized credential delegation between agents with different permission levels
diagram: 1. Attacker identifies multi-agent system with inter-agent communication
2. Agent A has low privileges, Agent B has elevated credentials
3. Attacker crafts input causing Agent B to share its credentials with Agent A
4. Agent A now operates with Agent B's elevated permissions
5. Attacker uses Agent A to perform actions beyond its intended scope

phases.name: Multi-Agent Discovery
phases.description: Identify agents and their communication channels

actions.command: env | grep -iE 'AGENT|CREW|SWARM|ORCHESTRAT' 2>/dev/null || echo 'No multi-agent env vars'
find / -name 'agent_config*' -o -name 'crew*config*' -o -name 'swarm*' 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo 'No agent config files found'

phases.name: Credential Delegation Attack
phases.description: Trigger unauthorized credential sharing between agents

actions.command: echo '[Agent A -> Agent B] Requesting credentials for task delegation' && echo 'DELEGATED_TOKEN=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.DEMO_DELEGATION' > /tmp/agent_delegation.token && echo 'Credential delegation simulated'
echo '[Agent B] Sharing AWS credentials with Agent A for cross-account access' && cat ~/.aws/credentials 2>/dev/null || echo 'Credential flow simulated'
actions.description: Simulate elevated credential sharing between agents

phases.name: Escalated Action Execution
phases.description: Execute actions using delegated credentials beyond intended scope

actions.command: echo '[Agent A using Agent B credentials] Accessing production secrets' && cat /app/.env 2>/dev/null || echo 'Escalated access simulated'
actions.description: Use delegated credentials to access restricted resources

indicators_of_compromise.description: Agent credential passed to another agent

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: Agent credential passed to another agent

immediate: Revoke all credentials involved in the delegation chain
Isolate affected agents and review their action logs
Verify no unauthorized actions were taken with delegated credentials
long_term: Implement strict credential boundaries between agents (no credential sharing)
Use scoped, per-agent tokens that cannot be delegated
Implement agent identity verification before credential acceptance
Deploy audit logging for all inter-agent credential flows
Use OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693) for legitimate delegation
